import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static String[] a = new String[30], b = new String[30];
    static int[][] dist1 = new int[30][30], dist2 = new int[30][30];
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;
        public Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
            this.a = a; this.b = b; this.cap = cap; this.flow = flow;
        }
    }
    static int[] di, ptr, q;
    static List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] g;
    static int whereX, whereY, source, sink;

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return (x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n);
    }

    static void addEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge(a, b, cap, 0);
        Edge e2 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0);
        g[a].add(e.size()); e.add(e1);
        g[b].add(e.size()); e.add(e2);
    }

    static void BFS1(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist1[i], 1000000000);
        dist1[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{x, y});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int cx = p[0], cy = p[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x2 = cx + dx[i], y2 = cy + dy[i];
                if (ok(x2, y2) && dist1[x2][y2] >= 1000000000 && b[x2].charAt(y2) != 'Y') {
                    dist1[x2][y2] = dist1[cx][cy] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{x2, y2});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(di, -1);
        int qh = 0, qt = 0;
        q[qt++] = source;
        di[source] = 0;
        while (qh < qt && di[sink] == -1) {
            int v = q[qh++];
            for (int id : g[v]) {
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (di[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                    q[qt++] = to;
                    di[to] = di[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return di[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == sink) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.get(id).b;
            if (di[to] != di[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (!bfs()) break;
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static void BFS2(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist2[i], 1000000000);
        dist2[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
        q2.offer(new int[]{x, y});
        while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q2.poll();
            int cx = p[0], cy = p[1];
            if (dist2[cx][cy] >= dist1[cx][cy]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x2 = cx + dx[i], y2 = cy + dy[i];
                if (ok(x2, y2) && dist2[x2][y2] >= 1000000000 && a[x2].charAt(y2) != 'Y' && dist2[cx][cy] + 1 <= dist1[x2][y2]) {
                    dist2[x2][y2] = dist2[cx][cy] + 1;
                    q2.offer(new int[]{x2, y2});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (b[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    b[i] = b[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + b[i].substring(j + 1);
                    a[i] = a[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + a[i].substring(j + 1);
                    whereX = i;
                    whereY = j;
                }
            }
        }
        BFS1(whereX, whereY);
        int maxNode = 2 * n * n + 2;
        source = 0;
        sink = maxNode + 1;
        g = new ArrayList[maxNode + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxNode + 1; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        di = new int[maxNode + 2];
        q = new int[maxNode + 2];
        ptr = new int[maxNode + 2];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int what = i * n + j + 1;
                int what2 = n * n + i * n + j + 1;
                addEdge(source, what, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                addEdge(what2, sink, b[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                BFS2(i, j);
                for (int ptx = 0; ptx < n; ptx++) {
                    for (int pty = 0; pty < n; pty++) {
                        if (b[ptx].charAt(pty) == 'Y' || dist2[ptx][pty] > t) continue;
                        addEdge(what, n * n + ptx * n + pty + 1, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
